name: Tempo de Natal
description: The page is about an event named "Tempo de Natal" scheduled for December 20th. It is hosted at Casa da Música.
longDescription:
The event "Tempo de Natal" is presented by Casa da Música. The page indicates the event will take place on December 20th. No specific start time or ticket pricing information is provided on this page. The event is listed within the agenda section of the Casa da Música website. 

The Casa da Música is located at Av. da Boavista, 604-610, 4149-071 Porto. The website also mentions various ensembles associated with Casa da Música, such as Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música and Remix Ensemble Casa da Música, but does not specify which, if any, will perform at this particular event.
